items.source: Implementations must implement this method to map each row of data in the ResultSet.
items.translation: 实现类必须实现此方法，以映射 `ResultSet` 中的每一行数据。

items.source: Determine the key to use for the given column in the column Map.
items.translation: 确定列映射中给定列所使用的键。

items.source: Retrieve a CQL object value for the specified column.
items.translation: 检索指定列的 CQL 对象值。

items.source: Create a Map instance to be used as column map.
items.translation: 创建一个Map实例用作列映射。

items.source: The Map implementation to use and the key to use for each column in the column Map can be customized through overriding createColumnMap(int) and getColumnKey(String), respectively.
items.translation: 用于的 Map 实现以及列中每个列 Map 所使用的键可以通过分别重写createColumnMap(int)和getColumnKey(String)来自定义。

items.source: Note: By default, ColumnMapRowMapper will try to build a linked Map with case-insensitive keys, to preserve column order as well as allow any casing to be used for column names. This requires Commons Collections on the classpath (which will be autodetected). Else, the fallback is a standard linked HashMap, which will still preserve column order but requires the application to specify the column names in the same casing as exposed by the driver.
items.translation: 注意：默认情况下，ColumnMapRowMapper 将尝试构建一个具有不区分大小写键的关联 Map，以保留列顺序并允许使用任意大小写的列名。这需要在类路径中包含 Commons Collections（该库将被自动检测）。否则，回退方案为标准关联 HashMap，它仍能保留列顺序，但要求应用程序指定列名时的大小写必须与驱动程序暴露的大小写一致。

items.source: The default implementation uses the getObject method.
items.translation: 默认实现使用getObject方法。

items.source: By default, a linked case-insensitive Map will be created.
items.translation: 默认情况下，将创建一个关联的不区分大小写的 Map。
